options: A single file stored in the cloud
The top-level container that holds Azure storage services like Blob Storage and Azure Files
A billing plan unrelated to any actual storage
A synonym for a virtual machine
questions.explain: Every Azure storage service lives inside a Storage Account, similar to how resources live inside a resource group.

questions.q: What does Blob Storage store, and what is it built for?
options: Nothing — it is a networking service, not a storage service
Unstructured data like images, video, logs, and backups, built to scale cheaply
Exclusively virtual machine operating system images
Only structured relational database tables
questions.explain: "Blob" stands for Binary Large Object — unstructured files at scale, cheaply.

questions.q: How is Azure Files accessed, and what makes it different from Blob Storage?
options: Only through a proprietary API with no shared-access capability
Over the standard SMB protocol, so multiple machines can mount the same share and read/write to it like a network drive
It is identical to Blob Storage with no functional difference
It cannot be accessed by more than one application at a time
questions.explain: Azure Files provides fully managed, SMB-accessible file shares — the cloud equivalent of mapping a network drive — which Blob Storage isn't built for.

questions.q: A team needs three application servers to simultaneously read and write to the same shared folder. Which service fits, and why?
options: A Virtual Machine is required to solve this instead of any storage service
Blob Storage — it's specifically designed for simultaneous shared-drive access
Azure Files — it's built for multiple machines mounting one shared drive, which Blob Storage doesn't support the same way
Neither service can support multiple machines accessing shared data
questions.explain: This is exactly the shared-drive scenario Azure Files solves via SMB, which Blob Storage — built for storing and retrieving unstructured files, not mountable shared access — isn't designed for.

It stays at the awareness/overview level; a deeper hands-on Storage Account course exists elsewhere in this catalog
It only covers pricing, with no conceptual explanation at all
It covers every configuration option in exhaustive technical depth
questions.explain: This lesson is intentionally an overview — making sure the services and their rough purpose are known — with deeper hands-on content available in a later course.
